elements.element: Customer owns deliverables and work product created for it
elements.evidence: the Company shall own all right, title and interest in and to the Site, including its design, look and feel, code and other deliverables and work product created by or for HDI under this Agreement

elements.element: Vendor assigns such deliverables/work product to Customer
elements.evidence: HDI hereby assigns to the Company all right, title and interest in and to such deliverables and work product
HDI shall retain ownership of its pre-existing intellectual property

elements.element: Licence to Vendor IP embedded in deliverables is perpetual
elements.evidence: grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to any HDI intellectual property embedded in the deliverables
royalty-free license to any HDI intellectual property embedded in the deliverables

elements.element: Licence scope covers any Vendor IP embedded in deliverables
elements.evidence: any HDI intellectual property embedded in the deliverables

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data
elements.evidence: The Company retains all right, title and interest in and to all data collected from or about users and customers of the Site ... ("Company Data")
Nothing in this Agreement shall create any joint ownership of intellectual property.

elements.element: Vendor owns generic tools and know-how
elements.evidence: clause says only "HDI shall retain ownership of its pre-existing intellectual property"; no reference to generic tools or know-how

elements.element: Customer licence to deliverables is worldwide
elements.evidence: licence is "perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free" with no "worldwide" grant

elements.element: Licence permits use, modification and sublicensing of deliverables
elements.evidence: no "use, modify and sublicense" language; licence limited to embedded HDI IP

reasons: The inserted section 5.5 completes every atomic element of the preferred position: Customer ownership of the Site and deliverables/work product, an express present assignment by HDI, HDI's retention of pre-existing IP, a perpetual/irrevocable/royalty-free licence to any embedded HDI IP, Customer retention of all rights in Company Data, and an express no-joint-ownership statement.

The fallback is not satisfied (no generic tools/know-how ownership, no worldwide, use/modify/sublicense deliverables licence), which is correct since the locked target is preferred and levels must not be mixed.
Minimal: the agreement had no ownership clause at all, so a single concise inserted section is the least intrusive fix; no preexisting sentence was altered and no fallback-only rights were bolted on.

Intent preserved: Company's editorial control (5.2), Content delivery (2.1) and General Manager provisions remain effective; "Company Data" is newly defined within the insertion and no dangling mechanic or contradiction is introduced.
